output: I understand that four-minute recalculation time is a real concern, especially with about six thousand SKUs spread across thirty-two distribution points. Very large models can slow down, and model design matters as much as the platform itself. During implementation, we review the model design with your team so the forecast is built to recalculate efficiently at your scale. Before you sign, we can also test performance on a sample of your own data. Our benchmark for recalculation time on a model sized like yours is [PLACEHOLDER] benchmark: recalculation time on a model sized like the prospect's. As a next step, I'd suggest a performance test on an anonymized sample of your largest model, and we would share the results with you before any commitment.
